Āḍhyarāja
praised by Bāṇa in Harṣacarita, intro. verses. Ref. to by Bhoja in his Śṛ. Pra. a. using the mark ‘Dhairya’ in his work. Ref. to also in his S. K. Ā. ch. II. The identification of Āḍhyarāja with Bāṇa's patron Harṣavardhana seems wrong. See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāra Prakāśa, p.. 829-831. See also Pischel, Gott. Nachr., 1901, p.. 485-7; J.. 1909, Jan.-June p. 167.
